The setwd() function in R is used to set the working directory, specifying where files will be read and saved during execution. In the code, the working directory points to a folder on my computer where project files are stored. Before running the script, users must replace the path with the location of their own project files. To find their folder’s path, users can navigate to it on their computer, copy the full directory address, and update it in the setwd() function.

```{r}
# setwd("path/to/project")  # set to the folder containing the data
```

## Library

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Packages used in the analysis (reconstructed from the code)
library(tidyverse)   # dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2, stringr, forcats
library(eurostat)    # Eurostat API
library(readxl)
library(sf)          # shapefiles and maps
library(kableExtra)  # tables
library(RColorBrewer)
library(reshape2)
```

## Population Evolution

```{r}
democrafic_information <-get_eurostat("tps00001", time_format = "num")
```

```{r}
democrafic_information |> 
  mutate(time_numeric = as.numeric(as.character(TIME_PERIOD))) |>  # Replace 'TIME_PERIOD' with the actual name if different
  filter(geo == "AT" & time_numeric <= 2023 & time_numeric >= 2014) |> 
    mutate(values_MIL = round(values / 1000000, 3)) |> 
    pivot_wider(c(-values, -indic_de, -geo, -TIME_PERIOD), names_from = "time_numeric", values_from = "values_MIL") |>  # Replace 'TIME_PERIOD' with the actual name if different
    kbl() |> 
  kable_minimal()
```

## Population density

```{r}
shapefile <- st_read("./Dataset_Market_Analysis_Austria_G7/LAU_RG_01M_2021_3035.shp") %>%
  filter(str_detect(`CNTR_CODE`, "AT"))
```

```{r}
data <- read_excel("./Dataset_Market_Analysis_Austria_G7/population_density.xlsx")
shapefile <- shapefile %>% rename(ID = LAU_ID)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID))
shapefile <- shapefile %>%
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID))
data <- shapefile %>%
  left_join(data, by = "ID")
data <- data %>%
  mutate(density_range = cut(`pop/km²`,
                             breaks = c(0, 10, 50, 100, 200, 300, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, Inf),
                             labels = c("0-10", "11-50", "51-100", "101-200", "201-300",
                                        "301-500", "501-1000", "1001-1500", "1501-2000",
                                        "2001-2500", ">2500")))
ggplot(data = data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = density_range), color = "grey30", size = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "0-10" = "#FFFFCC", "11-50" = "#FFEDA0", "51-100" = "#FED976",
    "101-200" = "#FEB24C", "201-300" = "#FD8D3C", "301-500" = "#FC4E2A",
    "501-1000" = "#E31A1C", "1001-1500" = "#BD0026", "1501-2000" = "#800026",
    "2001-2500" = "#67000D", ">2500" = "#4D000D"),
    na.translate = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Population Density in Austria by Municipality",
       fill = "Population Density Ranges") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = "Source: Statistics Austria",
           hjust = 1, vjust = -1, size = 3, fontface = "italic", color = "black")
```

## Population by age cohort

```{r}
get_eurostat("tps00010", time_format = "num") |>
  filter(geo=="AT" & TIME_PERIOD<=2023 & TIME_PERIOD>=2013) |>
  ggplot(aes(x=TIME_PERIOD,y=values,fill=indic_de))+
  geom_col(colour="black",alpha=.6,width=1)+
  geom_text(aes(x=TIME_PERIOD, y=values, label=paste(values,"%",sep="")),position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),size=3)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=2023:2013,minor_breaks=2023:2013)+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1",labels=c("<14","15-24","25-49","50-64","65-79",">80"))+
  labs(title="Population by age cohort",
       x = "Year",
       y = "%",
       fill="Age range",
       caption="Eurostat (tps00010/tps00001)")+
  theme(legend.position="right",
        legend.text=element_text(size=6),
        legend.key.size = unit(.5, "cm"),
        axis.text=element_text(size=8),
        axis.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size=8))
```

## Unemployment rate

```{r}
get_eurostat("tepsr_wc170", time_format = "num") |> 
  filter(geo == "AT" & TIME_PERIOD >= time_range[1] & TIME_PERIOD <= time_range[10]) |> 
  filter(age == "Y20-64") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = TIME_PERIOD, y = values)) + 
  geom_area(alpha = 0.8, fill = "#1f77b4", color = "black") + 
  geom_text(aes(label = paste(values, "%", sep = "")), size = 4, vjust = -1) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_range[1]:time_range[10], minor_breaks = time_range[1]:time_range[10]) +
  ylim(0, 7) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(
    title = "Unemployment Rate",
    subtitle = "Y20-64",
    y = "%",
    x = "Year",
    fill = "",
    caption = "Eurostat (tepsr_wc170)"
  ) + 
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8)
  )
```

## Unemployment by region

```{r}
unemployment_by_region <- get_eurostat("lfst_r_lfu3rt", time_format = "num")
```

```{r}
at.data <- unemployment_by_region%>% filter(TIME_PERIOD==2023 & age == "Y20-64" & str_detect(geo, "AT"))
codes <- read_xlsx("./Dataset_Market_Analysis_Austria_G7/NUTS2021-NUTS2024.xlsx", sheet = 1) %>%
  filter(`NUTS level` == 2) %>% # Only 
  filter(str_detect(`NUTS Code`, "AT")) # Only regions containing "AT" in the NUTS_ID
unemployment_by_region <- right_join(at.data, codes, by = c("geo" = "NUTS Code")) %>%
  select(-c(`NUTS level`, `Country code`, `Country order`, `#`)) %>%
  rename(region = `NUTS label`)
austria.reg <- st_read("./Dataset_Market_Analysis_Austria_G7/NUTS_RG_01M_2024_3035.shp")
```

```{r}
geographical_data <- full_join(
  at.data,
  austria.reg,
  by = c("geo" = "NUTS_ID") # Replace with actual column name in shapefile
)
ggplot(geographical_data %>% filter(TIME_PERIOD == 2023), aes(geometry = geometry, fill = values)) +
  geom_sf() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Unemployment rate (%)") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(
    title = "Unemployment Rate in Austria by Province",
    subtitle = "Working Age Population (20-64 years)",
    caption = "Source: Eurostat")
```

## Unemployment Rate Overall EU Countries

```{r}
       subtitle="2012-2023",

       x= "Year",
```

## GDP per capita

```{r}
get_eurostat("tec00115", time_format = "num") |> 
  filter(geo == "AT" & TIME_PERIOD >= time_range[1] + 1 & TIME_PERIOD <= time_range[10] & unit == "CLV_PCH_PRE_HAB") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = TIME_PERIOD, y = values, label = values, fill = values)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = 2) +
    geom_line(linetype = 2) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, alpha = .8, size = 8) +
    geom_text(hjust = .5, size = 2.5, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "green") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_range[1]:time_range[10], minor_breaks = time_range[1]:time_range[2], limits = c(time_range[1], time_range[10])) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs( title = "GDP per capita (% change on previous year, real values)", y = "%", x = "Year", fill = "value", caption = "Eurostat (tec00115)") +  
    theme(
        legend.position = "none", 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8))
```

## Consumption of food as percentage of GDP*

```{r}
food <- get_eurostat("tps00001", time_format = "num") |>
  filter(geo=="AT" & TIME_PERIOD<=2013 & TIME_PERIOD>=2023) |>
  mutate(values_MIL=round(values/1000000,3)) |>
  pivot_wider(c(-values,-indic_de,-geo),names_from ="TIME_PERIOD", values_from ="values_MIL")
warnings=FALSE
consumption_of_food <- get_eurostat('nama_10_co3_p3', time_format = "num")
```

```{r}
countries_EU <- c("IT","AT","BE","FR","DE","EL","PT","ES","FI","SK")
food <- consumption_of_food |> filter(coicop=="CP011") |> filter(geo %in% countries_EU & unit == "PC_GDP")
food |> filter(TIME_PERIOD==2022) |>
  ggplot(aes(x=fct_reorder(geo,values),y=values,fill=values))+
  geom_col(color="black",position=position_dodge(.9))+
  scale_fill_gradient(low="yellow",high="red")+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(title="Consumption of Food (% of GDP)",
       subtitle ="Year 2022",
       y = "%",
       x= "Country",
       fill="value",
       caption="Eurostat (nama_10_co3_p3)")+
  theme(legend.position="none",
        axis.text=element_text(size=8),
        axis.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1,size=8))
```

## Market Volumes*

```{r}
mvolumesAustria <- read_excel("./Dataset_Market_Analysis_Austria_G7/mvolumesAustria.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)
mvolumesAustria |>
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Year", values_to = "Volume", `2014`:`2023`) |>
  filter(Category == "Sweet Biscuits, Snack Bars and Fruit Snacks" &
           Geography == "Austria" &
           (`Data_Type` == "Total Volume") &
           Year <= time_range[10] &
           Year >= time_range[1]) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.integer(Year), y = Volume, label = round(Volume, 1))) +
  geom_col(colour = "black", alpha = .8, fill = brewer.pal(3, "Set2")[1]) +
  geom_text(aes(x = as.integer(Year), y = Volume, label = Volume), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_range[1]:time_range[10], minor_breaks = time_range[1]:time_range[10]) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Sweet Snacks: Volumes",
    subtitle = "Italy",
    y = "Tonnes ('000)",
    x = "Year",
    fill = "Volume",
    caption = "Source: Passport/Euromonitor"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right", 
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8), 
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8))
```

## Market Values: Cross-country comparison

```{r}
countries_selected <- c("Western Europe", "Austria", "Portugal", "Germany")
mvaluesAPGW <- read_excel("./Dataset_Market_Analysis_Austria_G7/mvaluesAPGW.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)
mvaluesAPGW |> pivot_longer(names_to = "Year", values_to = "Value", 7:16) |>
  filter(Category == "Sweet Biscuits, Snack Bars and Fruit Snacks" &
           Geography %in% countries_selected &
           `Data_Type` == "Retail Value RSP" &
           Year <= time_range[10] &
           Year >= time_range[1]) |>
  group_by(Geography) |>
  mutate(Fixed = (Value / Value[Year == time_range[1]]) * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.integer(Year), y = Fixed, label = round(Fixed, 1), fill = Geography, color = Geography)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, color = "blue", linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(alpha = .6, size = 1) +
  geom_point(alpha = 1, pch = 21, size = 10, fill = "white") +
  geom_text(size = 2.8) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_range[1]:time_range[9], minor_breaks = time_range[1]:time_range[9]) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Sweet Snacks: Values",
    subtitle = paste(time_range[1], "-", time_range[9], ", Index (", time_range[1], "=100)", sep = ""),
    y = "Index",
    x = "Year",
    color = "Country",
    caption = "Source: Passport/Euromonitor"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right", 
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8), 
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8) 
  )
```

## Average Prices

```{r}
countries_selected <- c("Western Europe", "Austria", "Portugal", "Germany")
averagepriceconstantpAPGW <- read_excel("./Dataset_Market_Analysis_Austria_G7/averagepriceconstantpAPGW.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)
d.price <-full_join(averagepriceconstantpAPGW |>
      pivot_longer(names_to = "Year", values_to = "Value", `2014`:`2023`) |>
      filter(Category == "Sweet Biscuits, Snack Bars and Fruit Snacks" & Geography %in% countries_selected & (`Data_Type` == "Retail Value RSP") & Year <= time_range[10] & Year >= time_range[1]), 
    averagepriceconstantpAPGW |>
      pivot_longer(names_to = "Year", values_to = "Volume", `2014`:`2023`) |>
      filter(Category == "Sweet Biscuits, Snack Bars and Fruit Snacks" & Geography %in% countries_selected & `Data_Type` == "Retail Volume" & Year <= time_range[10] & Year >= time_range[1]),
    by = c("Geography", "Year")
  ) |>
  select(Geography, Year, Value, Volume) |>
  mutate(Avg_Price = round(Value / Volume, 3))
d.price |> group_by(Geography) |> mutate(Fixed = (Avg_Price / Avg_Price[Year == time_range[1]]) * 100) |>
  filter(Geography == "Austria") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.integer(Year), y = Fixed, label = round(Fixed, 1))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, color = "blue", linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(alpha = .6, size = 1, color = brewer.pal(3, "Set2")[1]) +
  geom_point(alpha = 1, pch = 21, size = 10, fill = "white", color = brewer.pal(3, "Set2")[2]) +
  geom_text(size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_range[1]:time_range[2], minor_breaks = time_range[1]:time_range[2]) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Sweet Snacks: Average Retail Price",
    subtitle = paste(time_range[1], "-", time_range[2], ", Index (", time_range[1], "=100)", sep = ""),
    y = "Index",
    x = "Year",
    color = "Country",
    caption = "Source: Passport/Euromonitor"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right", 
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8), 
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8))
```

## Values Segments

```{r}
marketsegment <- read_excel("./Dataset_Market_Analysis_Austria_G7/marketsegment.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)
marketsegment|>
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Year", values_to = "Value", `2014`:`2023`) |>
  filter(Geography == "Austria" & `Data Type` == "Retail Value RSP") %>%
  filter(Category == "Fruit Snacks" | Category == "Snack Bars" | Category == "Sweet Biscuits") %>%
  group_by(Geography, Year) %>%
  mutate(Tot_Value = sum(Value)) %>%
  mutate(Share = (Value / Tot_Value) * 100) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = Share, fill = fct_reorder(Category, Share))) +
  geom_col(colour = "black", alpha = .6, width = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = Year, y = Share, label = paste(round(Share, 1), "%", sep = "")), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_range[1]:time_range[10], minor_breaks = time_range[1]:time_range[10]) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Sweet Snacks segments",
    subtitle = "Values, %",
    x = "Year",
    y = "%",
    fill = "",
    caption = "Passport/Euromonitor"
  ) + # labels
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size = unit(.5, "cm"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8)
  ) +
  coord_flip()
```

## Sweet Snacks Subsegments

```{r}
marketsegment %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Year", values_to = "Value", `2014`:`2023`) %>%
  filter(Geography == "Austria" & `Data Type` == "Retail Value RSP" & Year %in% time_range[1]:time_range[10]) %>%
  filter(Category == "Dried Fruit" | Category == "Processed Fruit Snacks" | Category == "Cereal Bars" | Category == "Protein/Energy Bars" | Category == "Fruit and Nut Bars" | Category == "Chocolate Coated Biscuits" | Category == "Cookies" | Category == "Filled Biscuits" | Category == "Plain Biscuits" | Category == "Wafers") %>%
  mutate(Main_category = ifelse(Category == "Dried Fruit" | Category == "Processed Fruit Snacks", "Fruit Snacks",
                                ifelse(Category == "Cereal Bars" | Category == "Protein/Energy Bars" | Category == "Fruit and Nut Bars", "Snack Bars",
                                       "Sweet Biscuits"))) %>%
  group_by(Geography, Year,Main_category) %>%
  mutate(Tot_Value = sum(Value)) %>%
  mutate(Share = (Value / Tot_Value) * 100) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = Share, fill = fct_reorder(Category, Share))) +
  geom_col(colour = "black", alpha = .6, width = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = Year, y = Share, label = paste(round(Share, 1), "%", sep = "")), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_range[1]:time_range[10], minor_breaks = time_range[1]:time_range[10]) +
  facet_wrap(~Main_category, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  labs(
    title = "Sweet Snacks Subsegments",
    subtitle = "Values, %",
    x = "Year",
    y = "%",
    fill = "",
    caption = "Passport/Euromonitor"
  ) + # labels
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size = unit(.5, "cm"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8)
  ) +
  coord_flip()
```

## Demand and supply

```{r}
Demand_and_supply <- read_excel("./Dataset_Market_Analysis_Austria_G7/Demand_and_supply.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)
volumes <- as.numeric(Demand_and_supply[2, 4:ncol(Demand_and_supply)])  
avg_prices <- as.numeric(Demand_and_supply[3, 4:ncol(Demand_and_supply)])
Demand_and_supply <- data.frame(
  Year = time_range,
  Volume = as.numeric(volumes),  
  Avg_Price = as.numeric(avg_prices)  )
ggplot(Demand_and_supply, aes(x = Volume, y = Avg_Price, size = Volume, label = Year)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", fill = "gray", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text(color = "black", size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_size(range = c(5, 15)) +
  labs(title = "Sweet Snacks",
       x = "Quantity (000 Tonnes)",
       y = "Average Price (EUR)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
```

## Share of revenue

```{r}
Market_size_retail_value <- read_excel("./Dataset_Market_Analysis_Austria_G7/Market_size_retail_value.xlsx", col_names = TRUE, skip = 1)
ice_cream <- as.numeric(Market_size_retail_value[2, 6:ncol(Market_size_retail_value)])
Sauvory_snack <- as.numeric(Market_size_retail_value[3, 6:ncol(Market_size_retail_value)])
Sweet_Biscuits <- as.numeric(Market_size_retail_value[4, 6:ncol(Market_size_retail_value)])
Confectionery <- as.numeric(Market_size_retail_value[1, 6:ncol(Market_size_retail_value)])
share_of_revenue <- data.frame(
  Year = time_range,
  Ice_Cream = ice_cream,
  Savory_Snack = Sauvory_snack,
  Sweet_Biscuits = Sweet_Biscuits,
  Confectionery = Confectionery)
share_of_revenue_long <- melt(share_of_revenue, id.vars = "Year",
                  variable.name = "Category",
                  value.name = "Share")
share_of_revenue_long$Total_Share <- ave(share_of_revenue_long$Share, share_of_revenue_long$Year, FUN = sum)
share_of_revenue_long$Share_Percentage <- (share_of_revenue_long$Share / share_of_revenue_long$Total_Share) * 100
ggplot(share_of_revenue_long, aes(x = Year, y = Share_Percentage, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#D0F0C0", "#F5A9BC", "#A9A9F5", "#FFCC99")) +
  labs(title = "Austria, Share of Revenues (RSP, Constant Prices) in Percentage",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Retail Value Share (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Income and Consumption

```{r}
cons_per_capita <- read_excel("./Dataset_Market_Analysis_Austria_G7/GDP_and_Total_volume.xlsx", col_names = TRUE, skip = 1)
cons_per_capita_filter <- cons_per_capita |>
  pivot_longer(names_to = "time", values_to = "values", 6:15) |>
  filter(!time == "2012",
         Data_Type == "Total Volume (Tonnes)")
cons_per_capita2 <- cons_per_capita_filter |>
  mutate(values = replace_na(as.numeric(values), 0)) |>  
  mutate(percentage_variation = (values - lag(values)) / lag(values) * 100) |> 
  mutate(percentage_variation = replace_na(percentage_variation, 0))  
GDP_PC <- get_eurostat("tec00115", time_format = "num") |>
  filter(geo == "AT" & TIME_PERIOD >= 2014 & TIME_PERIOD <= 2023 &
           unit == "CLV_PCH_PRE_HAB")
ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = 2, size = 0.75) +
  geom_line(data = GDP_PC, aes(x = as.numeric(TIME_PERIOD), y = values, color = "GDP_PC"), size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = GDP_PC, aes(x = as.numeric(TIME_PERIOD), y = values, color = "GDP_PC"), alpha = 0.8, pch = 16, size = 3.3) +
  geom_line(data = cons_per_capita2, aes(x = as.numeric(time), y = percentage_variation, color = "cons_per_capita"), size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = cons_per_capita2, aes(x = as.numeric(time), y = percentage_variation, color = "cons_per_capita"), alpha = 0.8, pch = 16, size = 3.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("GDP_PC" = "red", "cons_per_capita" = "darkgreen"),
                     labels = c("Volumes per capita", "GDP per capita")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2014:2023, minor_breaks = 2014:2023) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "GDP and Consumption (per Capita)",
       x = "Year",
       y = "%",
       fill = "value",
       caption = "Euromonitor") +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = NULL))
```

## Comparison of prices and Demand Curves between Countries

```{r}
Prices_and_Demand_Curves_between_Countries <- read_excel("./Dataset_Market_Analysis_Austria_G7/Prices_and_Demand_Curves_between_Countries.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)
prices_data <- Prices_and_Demand_Curves_between_Countries[Prices_and_Demand_Curves_between_Countries$`Data Type` == "Retail Value RSP", ]
quantities_data <- Prices_and_Demand_Curves_between_Countries[Prices_and_Demand_Curves_between_Countries$`Data Type` == "Total Volume (Tonnes)", ]

Austria_prices_numeric <- prices_data[1, 6:ncol(prices_data)]
Belgium_prices_numeric <- prices_data[2, 6:ncol(prices_data)]
Switzerland_prices_numeric <- prices_data[3, 6:ncol(prices_data)]

Austria_quantity_numeric <- quantities_data[1, 6:ncol(quantities_data)]
Belgium_quantity_numeric <-  quantities_data[2, 6:ncol(quantities_data)]
Switzerland_quantity_numeric <-  quantities_data[3, 6:ncol(quantities_data)]

Austria_prices_index <- (Austria_prices_numeric / Austria_prices_numeric$`2014`) * 100
Belgium_prices_index <- (Belgium_prices_numeric / Belgium_prices_numeric$`2014`) * 100
Switzerland_prices_index <- (Switzerland_prices_numeric / Switzerland_prices_numeric$`2014`) * 100

Austria_quantity_index <- (Austria_quantity_numeric / Austria_quantity_numeric$`2014`) * 100
Belgium_quantity_index <- (Belgium_quantity_numeric / Belgium_quantity_numeric$`2014`) * 100
Switzerland_quantity_index <- (Switzerland_quantity_numeric / Switzerland_quantity_numeric$`2014`) * 100

comparison_indexed <- data.frame(
  years = time_range,
  Austria_prices_index = as.numeric(Austria_prices_index),
  Belgium_prices_index = as.numeric(Belgium_prices_index),
  Switzerland_prices_index = as.numeric(Switzerland_prices_index),
  Austria_quantity_index = as.numeric(Austria_quantity_index),
  Belgium_quantity_index = as.numeric(Belgium_quantity_index),
  Switzerland_quantity_index = as.numeric(Switzerland_quantity_index))
comparison_long_price_indexed <- melt(
comparison_indexed,
  id.vars = "years",
  measure.vars = c("Austria_prices_index", "Belgium_prices_index", "Switzerland_prices_index"),
  variable.name = "Country",
  value.name = "Price")
comparison_long_quantity_indexed <- melt(
  comparison_indexed,
  id.vars = "years",
  measure.vars = c("Austria_quantity_index", "Belgium_quantity_index", "Switzerland_quantity_index"),
  variable.name = "Country",
  value.name = "Quantity")
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = comparison_long_price_indexed, aes(x = years, y = Price, color = Country), size = 1.5) +
  geom_line(data = comparison_long_quantity_indexed, aes(x = years, y = Quantity, color = Country), linetype = "dashed", size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Austria_prices_index" = "green",
    "Belgium_prices_index" = "orange",
    "Switzerland_prices_index" = "grey",
    "Austria_quantity_index" = "black",
    "Belgium_quantity_index" = "red",
    "Switzerland_quantity_index" = "yellow" )) +
  labs(
    title = "Indexed Prices and Quantities of Sweet Snacks (2014-2023)",
    subtitle = "Prices on solid lines, quantities on dashed lines (2014 = 100)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Index (2014 = 100)" ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, face = "italic"))
```

## Average employees per company

```{r}
avr_emp_old <- get_eurostat("sbs_na_ind_r2", time_format = "num") |> 
  filter(
    geo == "AT", 
    indic_sb %in% c("V16110", "V11110"), 
    TIME_PERIOD %in% 2014:2020, 
    nace_r2 %in% c("C", "C10", "C107", "C1072")) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "indic_sb", values_from = "values") |> 
  mutate(avg_value = V16110 / V11110) |> 
  mutate(source = "sbs_na_ind_r2")  
avr_emp_new <- get_eurostat("sbs_ovw_act", time_format = "num") |> 
  filter(
    geo == "AT", 
    indic_sbs %in% c("EMP_NR", "ENT_NR"), 
    TIME_PERIOD %in% 2021:2022, 
    nace_r2 %in% c("C", "C10", "C107", "C1072")) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "indic_sbs", values_from = "values") |> 
  mutate(avg_value = EMP_NR / ENT_NR) |> 
  mutate(source = "sbs_ovw_act") 
avr_emp_total <- bind_rows(
  avr_emp_old |> rename(EMP_NR = V16110, ENT_NR = V11110),
  avr_emp_new )
avr_emp_total <- avr_emp_total |> 
  mutate(sector = case_when(
    nace_r2 == "C" ~ "Manufacturing",
    nace_r2 == "C10" ~ "Food",
    nace_r2 == "C107" ~ "Bakery",
    nace_r2 == "C1072" ~ "Rusks and Biscuits"
  ))
ggplot(avr_emp_total, aes(x = as.integer(TIME_PERIOD), y = avg_value, fill = sector)) + 
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), color = "black", alpha = 0.8) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2014:2022, minor_breaks = 2014:2022) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Bakery" = "#4DAF4A", "Manufacturing" = "#E41A1C", "Food" = "#377EB8", "Rusks and Biscuits" = "#984EA3"))  + 
  labs(
    title = "Average Employees per Company by Sector", 
    subtitle = "Austria, 2014–2022", 
    y = "Average Number of Employees", 
    x = "Year", 
    fill = "Sector", 
    caption = "Source: Eurostat (sbs_na_ind_r2 & sbs_ovw_act)") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom", 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8), 
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"), 
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8), 
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8))
```

## Capital intensity

```{r}
capital_intensity <- get_eurostat("sbs_ovw_act", time_format = "num") %>%
  filter(
    geo == "AT",  
    indic_sbs %in% c("GRSINV_TNCA_MEUR", "NETTUR_MEUR" ),  
    TIME_PERIOD == 2022 ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = indic_sbs,
    values_from = values) %>%
  mutate(
    capital_intensity = (GRSINV_TNCA_MEUR / NETTUR_MEUR ) * 100 ) %>%
  select(geo, nace_r2, capital_intensity) %>%
  mutate(
    sector = case_when(
      nace_r2 == "C" ~ "Manufacturing",
      nace_r2 == "C10" ~ "Food",
      nace_r2 == "C107" ~ "Bakery",
      nace_r2 == "C1072" ~ "Snacks and biscuits",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Exclude other sectors
    )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sector))  
ggplot(capital_intensity, aes(x = sector, y = capital_intensity, fill = sector)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Capital Intensity (2022) in Austria by Sector",
    x = "Sector",
    y = "Capital Intensity (%)",
    fill = "Sector",
    caption = "Source: Eurostat (sbs_ovw_act)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```

```{r}
    values = c("Bakery" = "#4DAF4A", "Manufacturing" = "#E41A1C", "Food" = "#377EB8", "Rusks and Biscuits" = "#984EA3")
  )  +

    subtitle = "Austria, 2014–2023", 
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Expenditure on Goods and Services (% of Production Value)", 
    fill = "Sector", 
    caption = "Source: Eurostat (sbs_na_ind_r2 & sbs_ovw_act)") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "right", 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8), 
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
```

## Expenditure on personnel

```{r}
exp_on_pers_old <- get_eurostat("sbs_na_ind_r2", time_format = "num") |> 
  filter(
    geo == "AT", 
    indic_sb %in% c("V13310", "V12120"), 
    nace_r2 %in% c("C", "C10", "C107", "C1073"), 
    TIME_PERIOD %in% 2014:2020) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = indic_sb, values_from = values) |> 
  mutate(expenditure_percentage = (V13310 / V12120) * 100) |> 
  select(TIME_PERIOD, nace_r2, expenditure_percentage) |> 
  mutate(source = "sbs_na_ind_r2")  # Add source for tracking
exp_on_pers_new <- get_eurostat("sbs_ovw_act", time_format = "num") |> 
  filter(
    geo == "AT", 
    indic_sbs %in% c("EXPN_SAL_BEN_MEUR", "VAL_OUT_MEUR"), 
    nace_r2 %in% c("C", "C10", "C107", "C1073"), 
    TIME_PERIOD %in% 2021:2023 ) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = indic_sbs, values_from = values) |> 
  mutate(expenditure_percentage = (EXPN_SAL_BEN_MEUR / VAL_OUT_MEUR) * 100) |> 
  select(TIME_PERIOD, nace_r2, expenditure_percentage) |> 
  mutate(source = "sbs_ovw_act")  
exp_on_pers_total <- bind_rows(exp_on_pers_old, exp_on_pers_old)
exp_on_pers_total <- exp_on_pers_total |> 
  mutate(sector = case_when(
    nace_r2 == "C" ~ "Manufacturing",
    nace_r2 == "C10" ~ "Food",
    nace_r2 == "C107" ~ "Bakery",
    nace_r2 == "C1073" ~ "Rusks and Biscuits"
  ))
ggplot(exp_on_pers_total, aes(x = TIME_PERIOD, y = expenditure_percentage, fill = sector)) + 
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.9), color = "black", alpha = 0.8) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2014:2023) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") + 
  labs(
    title = "Expenditure on Personnel as % of Production Value", 
    subtitle = "Austria, 2014–2022", 
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Expenditure on Personnel (% of Production Value)", 
    fill = "Sector", 
    caption = "Source: Eurostat (sbs_na_ind_r2 & sbs_ovw_act)"
  ) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "right", 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8), 
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"), 
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8), 
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8))
```

## C4

```{r}
C4_2015 <- tibble(
  `Company Name` = c("Manner & Comp AG", "Bahlsen GmbH & Co KG", "Mondelez International Inc", "Griesson de Beukelaer GmbH & Co KG"),
  Market_Share = c(19.6, 13.6, 5.7, 2.7))
C4_2023 <- tibble(
  `Company Name` = c("Manner & Comp AG", "Bahlsen GmbH & Co KG", "Mondelez International Inc", "Hero Group GmbH"),
  Market_Share = c(20.4, 11.0, 5.7, 2.5))
c4_index_2015 <- C4_2015 %>%
  arrange(desc(Market_Share)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 4) %>%
  summarise(Year = 2015, C4_Index = sum(Market_Share))
c4_index_2023 <- C4_2023 %>%
  arrange(desc(Market_Share)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 4) %>%
  summarise(Year = 2023, C4_Index = sum(Market_Share))
c4_index_combined <- bind_rows(c4_index_2015, c4_index_2023)
c4_index_combined %>%
  kable("html", col.names = c("Year", "C4 Index (%)"), align = 'c', caption = "C4 Index for 2015 and 2023") %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "darkblue") %>%
  column_spec(2, bold = TRUE, color = "black", background = "lightgrey") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "darkblue")
```

## HHI

```{r}
Market_shares <- read_excel("./Dataset_Market_Analysis_Austria_G7/Market shares.xlsx", col_names = TRUE, skip = 5)
calculate_hhi <- function(data, year) {
  data %>%
    select(`Company_Name`, !!sym(as.character(year))) %>%
    rename(Market_Share = !!sym(as.character(year))) %>%
    filter(!`Company_Name` %in% c("Private Labels", "Other")) %>%
    mutate(
      Market_Share = as.numeric(Market_Share),
      Rescaled_Share = (Market_Share / sum(Market_Share, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100) %>%
    summarise(HHI = sum(Rescaled_Share^2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(HHI)}
hhi_2015 <- calculate_hhi(Market_shares, 2015)
hhi_2023 <- calculate_hhi(Market_shares, 2023)
hhi_table <- data.frame(
  Year = c(2015, 2023),
  HHI = c(hhi_2015, hhi_2023))
kable(hhi_table, col.names = c("Year", "HHI Index"), caption = "HHI Index for 2015 and 2023")
```

```{r}
hhi_table %>%

    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),  # Table styles
    full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "darkblue") %>%
  column_spec(2, bold = TRUE, color = "black", background = "lightgrey") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "darkblue")
```
